authority_policy: Official paper, repository, dataset card, and released evaluation code take precedence. Supplemental artifacts are compatibility inputs only.

benchmarks.description: Question answering over multi-party conversations for belief, answerability, information-access, and factual reasoning.

access.data_license: see upstream repository and constituent-data terms
access.constraints: Use the official evaluator and retain the control task; do not flatten conversations before sampling.

official_protocol.notes: Report short/full context and inaccessible/control scenarios separately; official leaderboard ordering prioritizes All* and then All. The paper reports 256 conversations, while the current official hash-pinned v1 payload contains 253 unique conversation IDs (0-255 with three IDs absent), 368 parts, and 870 sets.

benchmarks.description: Expert-written social theory-of-mind multiple-choice questions across six ATOMS dimensions.

access.constraints: The paper states that code and data will be released upon acceptance. The author-linked Hugging Face dataset exists but is empty at the pinned revision. Training questions must not be mixed into held-out evaluation.
access.unblock: Use an author-released artifact when available and pin its revision; otherwise provide a locally authorized copy matching the declared schema.

official_protocol.notes: The complete corpus has 800 questions: 700 train and exactly 100 test. The full held-out test is therefore the default.

benchmarks.description: Literary-character role playing at consequential four-option decision points.

access.constraints: The official repository supports the expert-written-description condition. Original books needed by other context-construction conditions are not redistributed.
access.unblock: Run the public expert-description condition, or configure lawfully acquired books for the other official conditions.

official_protocol.notes: Entity replacement and the paper's contamination controls must remain identifiable in manifests.

benchmarks.description: Persona-conditioned longitudinal behavior prediction and generation over connected behavior chains.

access.constraints: The paper reports 15,846 behaviors from 1,001 personas, but the official repository withholds the full dataset pending copyright resolution.
access.unblock: Request authorized data from the authors or provide a licensed local export. A local derivative snapshot must be labeled non-canonical.

official_protocol.split: official evaluation split (exact split cardinality unresolved)
official_protocol.notes: AvgScore and released-code CumScore are computed per complete chain, then macro-averaged across persona chains. Key/subkey is a node reporting slice, not a group sampling stratum. Official evaluation split size remains unresolved until data access.

benchmarks.description: Personalized chosen/rejected response evaluation conditioned on Reddit-derived user histories and profile variants.

access.constraints: Five official test variants are separate files. The dataset viewer currently reports a schema mismatch, so acquisition must verify file hashes and schemas locally.
access.unblock: Download the five files from the pinned revision after accepting their terms; validate schemas before use.

official_protocol.population: all rows in pinned Reddit_DEMO, Reddit_PAIR, Reddit_UGC, Reddit_arbitrary, and Reddit_history16 files
official_protocol.population_status: exact per-file counts unresolved from the official card
official_protocol.notes: Official Alignment Accuracy compares reference-adjusted chosen/rejected sequence margins. A deterministically side-assigned direct A/B generation score is diagnostic only and must not replace it. Never infer an exact population from file byte sizes.

benchmarks.description: Select the actually purchased item from 20 candidates using a user profile and purchase history.

access.constraints: The paper reports aggregate train/test sizes across six tasks but does not establish a separately released official item-selection test count. Third-party derivatives are not canonical.
access.unblock: Obtain the author-released Cognitive Genome item-selection split and record its revision and license, or provide a locally authorized schema-compatible split.

official_protocol.notes: Each record has one purchased item and 19 random negatives; use temperature 0.7 only when reproducing the paper's generation setting.

benchmarks.description: Generate the next response of a specific real user from a persona and single- or multi-turn context across six public-data domains.

access.data_license: CC-BY-NC-4.0 where declared; constituent source terms also apply
access.constraints: Use official chronological test splits and preserve the six domain identities. The checked-in 600-row manifest is a balanced research subset, not the full official leaderboard population.

official_protocol.split: official test split for each of six domains
official_protocol.notes: Official test generation uses temperature 0.4, no-repeat 4-gram decoding, permissive response-tag parsing, and up to 1024 tokens for thinking/HumanLM paths. Response alignment and six response-conditioned state alignment scores use the released LLM-judge prompts. The paper also reports embedding cosine similarity, but neither the paper nor pinned evaluation code identifies the embedding model; indieval therefore does not label any substituted encoder score as official.

benchmarks.description: User simulation evaluated intrinsically on held-out dialogue and extrinsically on PRISM and GSM8K/HumanEval-derived intent tasks.

access.data_license: WildChat/PRISM constituent terms; constructed intent suite unreleased
access.constraints: The model card explicitly says training/evaluation data processing scripts are not released. PRISM and the 65-intent extrinsic suite require independently lawful acquisition.
access.unblock: Provide the official 65-intent task file if released, or a documented local reconstruction from the named GSM8K/HumanEval sources; label reconstructions non-canonical.

official_protocol.notes: The paper's fixed assistant is GPT-4o. Assistant model and prompt must be recorded and changing either creates a protocol variant.

benchmarks.description: User simulation against a fixed customer-service agent in airline and retail tool-use tasks.

access.constraints: Research/evaluation use only; no LLM training, re-identification, or redistribution outside the dataset terms. The paper uses GPT-5.2 as the fixed assistant.
access.unblock: Accept the official dataset terms, download to a user-managed local path, pin the revision, and configure the fixed assistant endpoint.

official_protocol.split: 165 unique tasks with three human reference conversations per task
official_protocol.notes: Report every USI component. The composite is the mean of D1-D4, (1-ECE)*100, and Eval; Eval is 1-MAE.

benchmarks.description: Human-likeness evaluation for user simulators across four public dialogue datasets.

source.dataset: official acquisition scripts for ChatbotArena, ClariQ, OASST1, and QULAC

access.constraints: Dataset-specific licenses and provenance must be retained. Judge calls are repeated and confidence intervals are reported.

official_protocol.notes: Use the official fixed sampling seed, two judge calls, 95% confidence intervals, and dataset-specific robustness seeds (five for ChatbotArena, three for each other dataset) when running the robustness profile.

benchmarks.description: Long-horizon multi-character simulation grounded in novels and evaluated by a critic.

access.data_license: MIT on dataset card; underlying literary-source rights must still be respected
access.constraints: Use CoSER Test rather than training plots and preserve in-domain/out-of-domain labels.

official_protocol.notes: Official GCA uses GPT-4o-2024-08-06 as critic/environment, CoSER-70B as next-scene predictor, k=0, no hidden thoughts to the critic, and length correction lambda=1.5. Any substitution is a labeled variant.

benchmarks.description: Goal-directed two-agent social interaction in procedurally defined social environments.

access.constraints: SOTOPIA-Hard has changed across releases and papers. The run manifest must pin the installed package/dataset revision and list the resolved episode IDs instead of assuming a historical count.

official_protocol.split: SOTOPIA-Hard manifest for the pinned release
official_protocol.notes: The current official CLI documents a 100-simulation Sotopia Hard benchmark with a fixed Llama-3-70B partner; exact manifest and partner revision must be captured.

benchmarks.description: Profile-sensitive multi-agent social simulations with goals and implicit private information.

access.constraints: Judge identities and aggregation must be recorded; private information must not leak into other agents' visible prompts.

official_protocol.notes: The paper uses GPT-4o, Qwen2.5-72B, and Llama-3-70B judges. The cost-effective subset uses one profile-instantiation per template with repeated seeds.
